title: finding/1
description: One finding, in the format every specialist in the set writes (ITTEN, KERCKHOFFS, ERLANG). The core is the same for all of them; each keeps its own fields in an object named after itself, which this schema does not look inside. No field of a finding, its fingerprint and every extension included, holds secret material: a credential, token, key, password or session, or a hash of one. Name a secret by what it is (issuer, kind, prefix, length), never by its value. Adding an optional field keeps the format at finding/1; renaming or removing a field, or adding a required one, makes it finding/2. A report of findings is report/1 (report.schema.json). See protocol/04-inspect.md.

specialist.description: The specialist that wrote the finding, in lower case: itten, kerckhoffs, erlang.

check.description: The check, as the specialist names it.

fingerprint.description: The same for the same finding in every run, and different for different findings: two runs are compared by fingerprint. By convention the check, then the parts of where that identify the finding, joined by |, as in contrast|#nav > a or n-plus-one|api|GET /orders|src/routes/orders.js#listOrders. Built only from what stays the same between runs: never a measured value, a report id, a host or port, a record id, or the element's text.

measured.description: The paths of fields whose values differ between any two runs of the same subject (frame counts, durations, latencies, settle windows, benchmark figures). Dotted from the finding's root; [] means each item of a list; "message" means the numbers in the message. Everything not listed is compared exactly.

floor.description: The floor the check holds, if any. Where two specialists conflict, security floors come first, then accessibility floors, then craft (null).

detection.description: How the finding was detected; one finding can rest on several. render: measured in a browser on a rendered page. static: read from source, history or build output without running it. config: read from configuration. trace: read from telemetry of a run at low rate (spans, query logs, process metrics). live: observed by sending requests to a running deployment of the owner's own app. load: measured under generated load. Not part of the fingerprint: the same defect found statically and then confirmed live is one finding. Compared as a set; the order carries no meaning.

rules.description: Optional. The rules the finding comes from, as IDs from the specialist's own reference (LAY-03, AUZ-01, DAT-01). Citations of outside standards (WCAG, CWE, ASVS) stay in the specialist's extension.

where.description: What the finding is on: any of elements of a rendered page, places in code, endpoints of a service and named resources, at least one of them non-empty. A finding that shows in one place and is fixed in another lists both.

additionalProperties.description: A specialist's own fields, in an object named after it. Not validated here.

sel.description: A CSS selector for the element.

label.description: Tag and first class. Never the element's text.

text.description: The element's opening text, about 60 characters, for the reader only. Never compared between runs.

rect.description: x, y, width, height in CSS px, from the top left of the page.

location.description: A place in code. line is left out when the finding is about the file as a whole; column matters in minified output, where everything is on line 1.

symbol.description: The function, method, class or variable, such as listOrders or DATABASE_URL. A fingerprint built from file and symbol survives edits that move the line.

endpoint.description: An entry point of a running service.

method.description: For http, the HTTP method (GET, POST, ...). For other protocols, the operation in capitals, as the specialist names it.

route.description: A route template, never a concrete path: /users/:id/events, not /users/42/events. For a queue, the queue or topic; for a job, its name.

service.description: The service, where a repository holds more than one.

resource.description: A named thing in a running system or a site that is neither an element, a place in code nor an endpoint: a page as a whole, a table, a policy, a bucket, a queue, a pool, a whole service.

kind.description: page, table, policy, bucket, function, role, queue, cache, pool, service, ...

name.description: Stable between runs: a page's path without host or port, a table's qualified name (public.orders).
